name: Round 2 conditional error and abstention variance decomposition
registered_before: Any outcomes from this new population

analysis.diagnostic: Apply the already frozen predictive global solver to identical measured node tracks without refitting confidence. It is not accepted or deployed.

responses.conditional_rmse_m: Per-run RMS of matched episode horizontal errors. Null without matched fixes; never substitute zero. Report coverage and unmatched counts separately.
responses.scene_loss: Maximum min(error/10m,1) among matched episodes; one for any unmatched fix or no fix. Explicit bounded abstention/error loss, not an imputed metre error.

analysis.method: Additive categorical OLS, no interactions. Shapley decomposition of explained R-squared over all 32 factor subsets; residual fraction one minus full-model R-squared. Missing factor levels or zero response variance yield null, not a ranking.
analysis.intervals: 500 paired whole-seed cluster bootstrap draws, 95% percentile intervals, PRNG seed 781239. Preserve all factors, algorithms and realism profiles within each seed cluster.
analysis.limits: One fixed single-source free-field site, five noise/hardware seed clusters. The array factor includes aperture (180/230mm), geometry and current processing, not isolated physical shape. No field generalisation, algorithm acceptance, full nine-array ranking or hardware winner.
